Plugin name:
FS_ActualMessageFace
Author:
KrillDes
Version:
1.0.0
RPG maker version:
MZ
Release date:
6.02.2025
Terms of use/license:
here
Description:
The plugin allows you to automatically display the current face of the character in messages.
This functionality is useful for placeholders or even in large scenes during gameplay. The plugin is focused on the approach of systematizing character faces and distributing them into structures (directories).
Free download:
on the official website
A more detailed guide on working with the plugin is also on the website
